profiler.decision_trace_note: per-unit decision hashes and compact numeric summaries are recorded; full regional float arrays are intentionally not serialized, so trace overhead is identical across ordinary and instrumented modes.
profiler.overhead_note: Timing wrappers and cProfile (when enabled) add overhead; cProfile runs are not ordinary throughput measurements
profiler.producer_loss_attribution_note: producer_loss wall/process time is measured as one call; individual contrastive, reconstruction, and equivariance sub-loss timings are unavailable without invasive scientific tracing. Per-term loss values are recorded separately.

rng.note: fixture uses a local NumPy Generator; trainer RNG streams are not replaced

snapshot.note: immutable bytes captured before profiling; no masks or reference inputs
